dashboards.name: Metron Security Overview
dashboards.description: High-level security posture and alert summary

panels.title: Total Alerts (24h)
panels.query: FROM metron_alerts SELECT COUNT(*) WHERE timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '24' HOUR

panels.title: Alerts by Severity
panels.query: FROM metron_alerts SELECT severity, COUNT(*) WHERE timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '24' HOUR GROUP BY severity

panels.title: Alert Trend
panels.query: FROM metron_alerts SELECT COUNT(*) WHERE timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '24' HOUR GROUP BY time_bucket('1 hour', timestamp)

panels.title: Top Alert Source IPs
panels.query: FROM metron_alerts SELECT source_ip, COUNT(*) as alert_count WHERE timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '24' HOUR GROUP BY source_ip ORDER BY alert_count DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Top Triggered Rules
panels.query: FROM metron_alerts SELECT rule_name, COUNT(*) as count WHERE timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '24' HOUR GROUP BY rule_name ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 10

dashboards.name: Network Security Monitor
dashboards.description: Network traffic analysis and threat detection

panels.title: Network Traffic Volume
panels.query: FROM netflow SELECT SUM(dOctets) as total_bytes, SUM(dPkts) as total_packets GROUP BY time_bucket('1 minute', timestamp)

panels.title: Top Talkers by Volume
panels.query: FROM netflow SELECT srcaddr, SUM(dOctets) as bytes_out, SUM(dPkts) as packets_out GROUP BY srcaddr ORDER BY bytes_out DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Port Scan Alerts
panels.query: FROM metron_alerts SELECT COUNT(*) WHERE rule_id = 'METRON-002' AND timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '1' HOUR

panels.title: Lateral Movement Alerts
panels.query: FROM metron_alerts SELECT source_ip, destination_ip, timestamp WHERE rule_id = 'METRON-007' AND timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '24' HOUR ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Data Exfiltration Alerts
panels.query: FROM metron_alerts SELECT source_ip, destination_ip, bytes_transferred WHERE rule_id = 'METRON-003' AND timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '24' HOUR ORDER BY bytes_transferred DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Protocol Distribution
panels.query: FROM netflow SELECT prot, COUNT(*) as count GROUP BY prot ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 10

dashboards.name: Web Security Monitor
dashboards.description: HTTP traffic analysis and web attack detection

panels.title: HTTP Requests/sec
panels.query: FROM http SELECT COUNT(*) as rps GROUP BY time_bucket('1 second', timestamp)

panels.title: HTTP Status Code Distribution
panels.query: FROM http SELECT status, COUNT(*) as count GROUP BY status ORDER BY count DESC

panels.title: Top Requested URLs
panels.query: FROM http SELECT request, COUNT(*) as hits GROUP BY request ORDER BY hits DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: SQL Injection Attempts
panels.query: FROM metron_alerts SELECT source_ip, request, timestamp WHERE rule_id = 'METRON-006' AND timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '24' HOUR ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Web Shell Alerts
panels.query: FROM metron_alerts SELECT source_ip, request, timestamp WHERE rule_id = 'METRON-005' AND timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '24' HOUR ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Top User Agents
panels.query: FROM http SELECT user_agent, COUNT(*) as count GROUP BY user_agent ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: SSH Brute Force Attempts
panels.query: FROM metron_alerts SELECT source_ip, hostname, attempt_count, timestamp WHERE rule_id = 'METRON-001' AND timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '24' HOUR ORDER BY attempt_count DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Privilege Escalation Alerts
panels.query: FROM metron_alerts SELECT source_ip, hostname, timestamp WHERE rule_id = 'METRON-009' AND timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '24' HOUR ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Syslog Severity Distribution
panels.query: FROM syslog SELECT severity, COUNT(*) as count GROUP BY severity ORDER BY count DESC

panels.title: Top Syslog Sources
panels.query: FROM syslog SELECT hostname, COUNT(*) as event_count GROUP BY hostname ORDER BY event_count DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Failed Login Attempts Over Time
panels.query: FROM syslog SELECT COUNT(*) as failures WHERE message CONTAINS 'Failed password' GROUP BY time_bucket('5 minutes', timestamp)

dashboards.name: Threat Intelligence Monitor
dashboards.description: Threat intel matches and IOC tracking

panels.title: Threat Intel Matches (24h)
panels.query: FROM metron_threat_intel_matches SELECT COUNT(*) WHERE timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '24' HOUR

panels.title: Matches by IOC Type
panels.query: FROM metron_threat_intel_matches SELECT ioc_type, COUNT(*) as count GROUP BY ioc_type

panels.title: Matches by Threat Feed
panels.query: FROM metron_threat_intel_matches SELECT feed_name, COUNT(*) as count GROUP BY feed_name ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Recent Threat Intel Matches
panels.query: FROM metron_threat_intel_matches SELECT ioc_value, ioc_type, feed_name, matched_ip, timestamp ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: Match Confidence Distribution
panels.query: FROM metron_threat_intel_matches SELECT confidence, COUNT(*) as count GROUP BY confidence
